auth.verify.title: Confirm it is you
auth.verify.description: Your password or your link was accepted. One more proof is needed before the session opens.
auth.verify.totpHint: Open the app that generates your codes and copy the one shown for InfoKit.
auth.verify.smsHint: The code goes to the number enrolled on this account and expires after 10 minutes.
auth.verify.sent: The code was sent. It can only be used once.
auth.verify.backupHint: Use this if you no longer have your phone. Each code works only once.
auth.verify.invalid: That code is incorrect, expired, or has already been used.
auth.verify.locked: Too many incorrect codes. The account is locked for fifteen minutes.
auth.verify.noPhone: No number is enrolled on this account. Use your authenticator app or a backup code.
auth.verify.rateLimited: Too many codes were requested. Try again shortly.
auth.verify.sendError: The SMS could not be sent. Try again shortly.
auth.verify.startAgain: Start again with a different email address
auth.verify.signOut: Sign out and use a different address
auth.device.title: Back to the app
auth.device.body: You are signed in. Open the InfoKit app to finish — the link below does it.
auth.device.expires: This link works once and expires after two minutes. After that, ask for a new link from the app.
auth.device.failed: The sign-in could not be handed to the app. Ask for a new link from the app.
auth.enrol.title: Enrol your mobile number
auth.enrol.description: Your role opens up accounts, coordination data, and published content. Confirm a number now: every sign-in will then ask for a code sent by SMS.
auth.enrol.why: Why this number is required for you
auth.enrol.whyHint: A password or an emailed link can be stolen without anyone noticing. For roles that reach other people’s accounts and work, the platform requires a second proof: a code sent to the phone only you are holding. The number is used for signing in and security alerts only, and never appears on the public site.
auth.enrol.phoneHint: International format, country code included. For example: +33 6 12 34 56 78.
auth.enrol.invalidPhone: That number cannot be read. Write it in international format, for example +33 6 12 34 56 78.
auth.verify.trustDeviceHint: No code will be asked for on this browser for the next 14 days. Leave it unticked on a shared or public computer; you can undo it any time from your account security page.
